title: Show failed registered-run aggregates in verification notes and acceptance reads
outcome: An agent reading verification notes or acceptance binding evidence can see when a passing stage belongs to a failed or indeterminate registered run.
acceptance: Verification notes and acceptance verification reads expose the registered producer's aggregate failure or indeterminate outcome alongside or conservatively combined with the stage outcome; they do not present only passed/succeeded for that case.
Existing execution-observation records keep their stored meaning, and any host-protocol shape change is reconciled with its actual consumer.
Focused regressions cover passing stages from failed and indeterminate aggregates on both read surfaces and preserve admission, binding and completion refusal.
